component.name: Tibia
component.summary: Tibia is a free massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG).

description.p: Tibia is one of the oldest and most successful massively multiplayer online role-playing games (MMORPG) created in Europe. In an MMORPG people from all over the world meet on a virtual playground to explore areas, solve tricky riddles and embark on heroic adventures.

For more than 25 years now, players have been visiting the medieval world of Tibia. Today, more than 500,000 players from all over the world inhabit the Tibian continent, enjoying its numerous game features.

As knights, paladins, monks, sorcerers or druids, players develop their characters' skills, exploring a large variety of areas and dangerous dungeons and interacting with other players on a social and diplomatic level. Beyond its sophisticated chat tools, Tibia stands out for the unparalleled freedom it offers, creating an immensely immersive gaming experience.

Tibia can be played free of charge as a matter of principle. However, your account can be upgraded anytime to a Premium account. Advantages of Premium accounts include the access to special game areas and items as well as further special features relating to the game.
